title: Random picks on a slashed board draw only from the cards they reach
notes: R3554003: MC Tech's base Cry, Arcane Missiles, Snom Bunny's Death, Casper's Activate and Siva 1's Cry draw their random pick only among the cards they reach on a slashed board; their v0.6.9i scripts are kept for replays (R767000).

player.title: Random picks respect the slash
fixes: On a board split by Slashed Dream Cries in Red, MC Tech, Arcane Missiles, Snom Bunny, Casper and Siva 1 sometimes picked a card on the far half, and the effect did nothing.
Each now picks only among the cards on its own half that it can affect, so the pick is never wasted on a card out of its reach.
